scope: All 170 project standalone raster and SVG image files listed in SourceFiles.txt. Ignored build products, output/imagegen, local generation caches, Git history-only images, embedded image bytes and optional user data are excluded.
license_basis: Root LICENSE and project distribution declaration. External reference-image permissions are not inferred from the generated outputs.
image_model_note: Retained generation records do not identify the exact image-generation model. No model identity is inferred for individual files.
verification_note: Byte matches use SHA-256 or complete-file comparison. Pixel matches include BMP alpha bytes for 32-bit BI_RGB files. Reproductions ran only in a temporary directory; repository images were not changed. Git introduction times are commit author dates, not generation dates.
